name: Steinbacher
beschreibung: The Holiday Apartment Steinbacher is located on the outskirts of Schwoich, a small village in the Tiroler Unterland. The surroundings are rural, with meadows and mountain slopes; the center of Kufstein can be reached by car in a few minutes. Guests can expect a simple, furnished apartment with a kitchen and balcony, suitable for self-catering. The property is a suitable starting point for hikes and excursions into the Kaisergebirge.
